message: widget-marker (`./wrap` exports `PctWidget` under that name; `./other` exports `PctMarker` under that name)
$reason: The decorated `PctGhost` of `./widget` is exported by nothing; `./other` exports `PctMarker` under its name and `./wrap` exports `PctWidget` under it. The refusal names each entrypoint that holds the name, not the one the class sits in, and nothing else: by export key the package had a `PctGhost`, refused as the class exported from another entrypoint than its own.
